title: PERFORM'CAR, XPEL PPF expert
subtitle: The specialist in premium automotive protection, an XPEL certified center in Marcoussis, Paris Saclay.

story.title: Founded by car enthusiasts
story.p1: PERFORM'CAR is an XPEL approved center in Marcoussis, Essonne. As a certified XPEL PPF center, the world's reference brand for automotive protection films, we have protected more than a thousand exceptional vehicles.
story.p2: PerformCar EasyDevis carries the same standard: a tool to issue, finance and track accurate, professional quotes for our partner dealerships.

values.title: Our mission: protect your passion with excellence and precision
values.item1Desc: Supercars, premium vehicles, motorcycles: every vehicle gets the same care.
values.item2Desc: XPEL products with a 10-year warranty and expertise recognized by our partners.
values.item3Desc: Attention to detail, the signature of excellence, from film installation to the quote.
values.item4Desc: Prices taken from the catalog and frozen on every quote, with no surprises for the customer.
